title: A Busy Week for Sam
text:
Sam is sixteen years old. He goes to school in the morning and plays football with his team after class. On Tuesdays he has a math exam, so he studies every evening.

On weekends, Sam meets his friends at the park. They talk, listen to music, and sometimes they cook dinner together. Sam says his friends help him relax after a hard week.

questions.text: Where does Sam meet his friends on weekends?
Why does Sam study every evening?
options: He has a math exam on Tuesday
He wants to become a teacher
His parents are angry with him

questions.text: What can we infer about Sam's friends?
options: They are good company and help him feel better
They are often angry with him

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who play a sport together
a test at school or university

paragraph_translations: Sam tiene dieciséis años. Va a la escuela por la mañana y juega fútbol con su equipo después de clase. El martes tiene un examen de matemáticas, así que estudia todas las noches.
Los fines de semana, Sam se reúne con sus amigos en el parque. Hablan, escuchan música y a veces cocinan la cena juntos. Sam dice que sus amigos le ayudan a relajarse después de una semana difícil.
